crew.overview: Bobby Griffith was his mother's favorite son, the perfect all-American boy growing up under deeply religious influences in Walnut Creek, California. Bobby was also gay. Struggling with a conflict no one knew of, much less understood, Bobby finally came out to his family.
crew.title: Prayers for Bobby

details.biography: Stanley M. Brooks is a film and television producer. Brooks served as President of Guber-Peters Television. In 1989, he founded his first independent production company, Once Upon a Time Films.  He started a new company, Stan & Deliver Films, in 2011.
details.name: Stanley M. Brooks
